name: node-sse-api
title: Node SSE API
blurb: Server-sent events service on bare Node: a replayable event log, Last-Event-ID resumption, heartbeat comments, node --test plus a live streaming contract
default_description: A server-sent events service with replay.

verify.name: stream
verify.cmd: if curl -s --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5469/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5469 is already answering - stop that process before running this step'; exit 1; fi; SSE_HEARTBEAT_MS=200 PORT=5469 node src/main.js >.node-sse.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl -s --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5469/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; kill -0 $srv 2>/dev/null || { echo 'the server exited before it answered'; cat .node-sse.log; exit 1; }; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .node-sse.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; node tools/contract.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:5469 --expect-heartbeat; rc=$?; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; test $rc -eq 0
